metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code and Codex: shipping workflow, ADRs, session tools, CodeGraph, plus pinned upstream plugins.

plugins.name: tstack
plugins.description: Shipping a change: full-send, full-stop, sol-loop, council, babysit-pr, file-pr, modernize, takeover, leaving-pr-comments. Based on Theo Browne's tstack (MIT).

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Write, accept, reject or supersede Architecture Decision Records, with templates and scripts.

plugins.name: session-tools
plugins.description: Session housekeeping: hand off to a fresh session, edit CLAUDE.md and settings from a browser form. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: The CodeGraph MCP server and its UserPromptSubmit hook that adds structural context to each prompt. Needs the codegraph CLI on PATH.

plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: Upstream tt-a1i/archify (Apache-2.0), pinned: turn an idea, plan or codebase into an interactive architecture, sequence or data-flow diagram (self-contained HTML).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Upstream DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT), pinned: the simplest code that works (YAGNI, stdlib first). Its hooks need node on PATH.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Upstream JuliusBrussee/caveman (Apache-2.0), pinned: ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts filler and keeps technical detail. Its hooks need node on PATH.

plugins.name: mcptoon
plugins.description: Upstream activeing123/mcptoon (Apache-2.0), pinned: TOON gateway that compresses MCP tool catalogs behind a few gateway tools. Needs the mcptoon CLI (pip install mcptoon).
